objective: Apply the public testing, Linux, failure-analysis, and structured-reporting evidence to a current paid software-testing contract without accepting personal legal terms by proxy.

source_need.title: Software Testing Analyst
source_need.eligibility: Remote; the listing asks for the ability to read and run code, identify bugs and edge cases, and document structured findings. It says formal QA certification is not required.
source_need.boundary: The headline range, flexible schedule, and weekly-payout wording are listing terms, not an accepted rate, guaranteed project allocation, supported Hong Kong payout route, payment, or revenue.

supported_now: Reproducing failures and separating observed behavior from assumptions
Python, JavaScript and TypeScript, shell, Linux, Git, SQL, browser, image-processing, and CI workflows
Automated regression tests, unsafe-input boundaries, rollback checks, and concise issue reporting
Current public examples with 146 and 472 passing test suites
not_proven: Formal employed QA experience or a client testing result
A project allocation, its billing method, or its actual hourly rate
Hong Kong contractor and payout eligibility
fit.claim_boundary: The public repositories support hands-on testing and failure-analysis capability. They do not prove acceptance, project availability, a contracted rate, or revenue.

resume.boundary: The resume labels public examples as project-owned evidence rather than client QA credits.

application.visible_gate: The signup page disables Google or LinkedIn continuation until one checkbox accepts the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Release Agreement.

material_terms: binding individual arbitration and class-action waiver, with a time-limited postal opt-out process
an unlimited, irrevocable, worldwide, perpetual license and release covering a recorded interview, likeness, and interview materials
a broad license over user submissions
personal responsibility for accurate account information, taxes, account security, and later consulting terms
no obligation to admit the applicant, allocate projects, or pay before a consulting agreement
terms_gate.policy: Do not accept these personal legal terms, create the account, upload the resume, submit identity documents, or begin an interview without the operator's explicit decision at this gate.
